examples.arabic: إخواته البنات بيحبوا العيش المصري أوي.
examples.english: His sisters love Egyptian bread very much.
examples.transliteration: Ekhwato el banat beyhebu el eish el masri awi.

examples.arabic: هما كانوا لابسين تيشيرتات حمراء بتاعة المنتخب المصري.
examples.english: They were wearing red shirts belonging to the Egyptian national team.
examples.transliteration: Homa kano labsin t-shirtat hamra beta'et el montakhab el masry.

examples.arabic: هما بيروحو يشوفو قاعه عشان فرح مصري
examples.english: They go to see a wedding hall for an Egyptian wedding.
examples.transliteration: homma beyrouhou yeshoufou qaa'a ashan farah masri

examples.arabic: انا كنت فاكر انه مصري عشان بيتكلم عربي كويس
examples.english: I thought he was Egyptian because he speaks Arabic well.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont faker inno masry ashan beyetkallem araby kwayyes.

examples.arabic: مارك قاله انا فاكر انت مصري بس بتعرف تعمل كل حاجة
examples.english: Mark told him, "I remember you are Egyptian, but you know how to make everything."
examples.transliteration: Mark 'alo ana faker enta masry bas bete'raf te'mel kol haga.

examples.arabic: السفرة مليانة اكل مصري شهي زي الملوخية والرز والمحشي وكلنا قعدنا حواليها
examples.english: The dining table was full of delicious Egyptian food like molokhia, rice, and mahshi, and we all sat around it.
examples.transliteration: El sofra malyana akl masri shahi zay el molokheya we el rozz we el mahshi we kollena qa'adna hawalayha
